recordedSemantics.length: Python len is retained, including Python string code-point counts; exact/custom bound comparisons preserve minimum-first short-circuit, reflected comparison dispatch, truth conversion and exception identity.
recordedSemantics.allowed: The iterable is consumed in order; only same-type candidates are compared; equality dispatch is candidate-side and its truth conversion, short-circuit and exceptions are preserved.
recordedSemantics.decimal: Finite decimal equality is numeric equality across different tuple spellings and signed zero; NaN is unequal, and signaling NaN may raise the original decimal exception.
recordedSemantics.identity: Successful validation returns the exact input object.
